name: Delicate Instruments

angles.text: As a mage, you know careless spells from amateurs like the Defias rogue wizards can send wild fluctuations across Elwynn and disrupt sensitive magical research.
As an Alliance member, you help keep eastern Elwynn Forest secure from Defias encroachment by maintaining order around the Tower of Azora.

faq.answer: Hamish Bergwort offers Delicate Instruments from the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He needs stable magical conditions for his research.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Delicate Instruments?

faq.answer: Crude spells from Defias bandits near Stone Cairn Lake interfere with the instruments in the Tower of Azora.
faq.q: What is disrupting Hamish Bergwort's instruments?

aliases: where to find defias rogue wizards
faq.answer: The Defias rogue wizards gather along the shores and surrounding grounds of Stone Cairn Lake, just north of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Where can the Defias Rogue Wizards be found?

faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has recruited renegade dabblers in the arcane. These rogue wizards practice magic without sanction and cause erratic disturbances in the region.
faq.q: Why are Defias bandits practicing magic?

faq.answer: The Tower of Azora is an arcane spire in eastern Elwynn Forest. Human magi and scholars study ley lines, magical anomalies, and regional security there.
faq.q: What is the Tower of Azora?

faq.answer: Yes. Once you cull the Defias rogue wizards casting at Stone Cairn Lake, the magical resonance calms and Hamish Bergwort's apparatus works properly again.
faq.q: Does eliminating the rogue wizards fix the problem?

sections.body: Hamish Bergwort studies arcane questions in the Tower of Azora. His work depends on precise readings, and even a slight change in local magic can ruin hours of careful study. He suspects crude spells nearby are causing the interruptions.
sections.title: Interference at the Tower

sections.body: Defias rogue wizards practice magic near Stone Cairn Lake, and their casting causes the interference. Their unchecked spellcraft brings unstable magic into Elwynn. End their casting, and the disturbance will cease, allowing Bergwort's instruments to give clean readings.
sections.title: Banditry and the Arcane

summary: At the Tower of Azora, Defias magic troubles Delicate Instruments. Hamish Bergwort's equipment suffers from erratic spellcasting near Stone Cairn Lake. The disturbance must end before his instruments can work properly.
